name: Parks Closure Status Due to COVID-19: Dog Runs
description:
This dataset tracks the closure and reopening status of dog runs in New York City parks during the COVID-19 pandemic. Each of the 85 rows represents a single dog run, identified by its name, property name, and park system ID, along with its borough (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, or Staten Island) and park district. Records include the closure type (all listed as "Completely Locked"), the current status (mostly "Reopened," with a few "UnderConstruction" or still "COVID-19 Closure"), approximate closure and reopening dates, and edit timestamps. Several fields capture operational details such as whether a red sign was installed, whether a yellow sign was removed, and sub-property or zone names. A polygon column provides geographic boundaries for mapping.

The data could be used to analyze the timing and geographic distribution of dog run closures and reopenings across the city, compare borough-level patterns, map affected locations, or study how park amenities were managed during
